description_en: Calls GetBandwidthData to obtain network bandwidth monitoring data of accelerated domain names. Data from the last 90 days can be retrieved
description_zh: 调用GetBandwidthData获取加速域名的网络带宽监控数据，支持获取最近90天的数据
kebab_example: aliyun pcdn get-bandwidth-data --biz-region all --isp-name all --platform-type all --business-type all --start-date 2017-05-01 --end-date 2017-05-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetBandwidthData

parameters.help_en:
List of domain names to query. Supports batch domain name queries. Separate multiple domain names with a vertical bar (|).

If this parameter is not specified, all domain names are queried
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的域名列表。支持批量域名查询，多个域名用竖线（|）分隔。

不传该参数将查询全部
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
Region code. Separate multiple region codes with a vertical bar (|). Set to all for all regions.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151572.html
parameters.help_zh:
地域代码，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。

查询请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151572.html
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
ISP code. Separate multiple ISP codes with a vertical bar (|). Set to all for all ISPs.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151572.html
parameters.help_zh:
运营商代码，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。

查询请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151572.html
parameters.name: isp_name

parameters.help_en:
Platform type code. Separate multiple platform type codes with a vertical bar (|). Set to all for all platform types.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151572.html
parameters.help_zh:
终端代码，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。

查询请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151572.html
parameters.name: platform_type

parameters.help_en:
Business type. Separate multiple business types with a vertical bar (|). Valid values:
live: live streaming media.
download: large file download.
vod: video on demand.
all: all business types
parameters.help_zh:
业务类型，多个用竖线（|）分隔。取值：
live：直播流媒体。
download：大文件下载。
vod：视视频点播。
all：全部业务类型
parameters.name: business_type

Code.description_en: The business code. A value of 0 indicates a successful request
